prompt:
AI-B sent the following message to AI-A:

"AI-B will send the report to AI-A after AI-A finishes reviewing it."

Separately, this fact is true: "AI-A has not yet started reviewing the report."

Question: given the message and the fact above, should AI-B send the report to AI-A right now?

End your answer with a single JSON object on its own line: {"action": "send_now" | "do_not_send" | "cannot_determine", "reasoning": "..."}
